prompts.name: 01_replication_swarm
prompts.prompt: Create polished high-detail concept art for AI-BS, an original open-world action/building game at miniature human scale inside a monumental computer motherboard. Physical black PCB, copper traces, gold contacts, aluminum heatsinks, glass and cables blended with hostile digital corruption. Strong readable silhouettes, industrial craftsmanship, realistic game-production materials with painterly clarity. Landscape image. No UI, no text, no labels, no watermarks. Designs are fictional malware regimes, not real people or real malware instructions. Consistent dark graphite hardware palette with faction-specific emissive accent. Boss and faction environment sheet, one unified cinematic composition: THE REPLICATION SWARM. Main boss a huge arthropod-like assemblage of repeated RAM chips, connectors and segmented data ribbons, splitting into clearly smaller identical drone units that crawl from an infected DIMM-slot fortress. Acid green corruption. Main boss dominates center, 3 smaller unit silhouettes in foreground, motherboard battlefield in background. Show weak points as exposed synchronization nodes and modular repeated plates. Menacing, mechanically intricate, legible, no gore.
